notes.title: Small update and input changes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
In an effort to optimize the game we've changed a few things that we want you to know about:

[list]
[*] Some models of the rides have been changed to the new ones we are using on our main game. This reduces geometry and helps boost performance.
[*] Materials and textures on several surfaces have been updated to fit the new models and improve the realism of the game.
[*] The VR controllers specific to each headset are no longer supported. We've added a new keyboard/ Xbox controller input scheme that provides a smoother and easier to use experience.
[*] New menu interface with a look-and-press control system, replacing the old grabbing system.
[*] New in-game menu that can be hidden instead of being always attached to the controllers.
[/list]


We hope that these changes help to create a better experience for everyone.

Best regards,
GuraShop
